author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Fake Bloomberg, Opus 4.6 vs GPT-5.3

I think I hit a fundamental limit of LLM.  LLM thinks in words.  Although I gave the AI coding agent real Bloomberg screenshots for reference, it just can't match the look 100%.   If you describe the fake Bloomberg and the real Bloomberg is words, the description is very similar.   The detail is lost in the image to words translation, which are very obvious to human eyes

Both still look fake, but which one you like better?
